instruction: Show the number one: index finger up, other fingers curled.
notes: Source: 'Index finger extended.' Middle and ring curled (source silent, standard closed hand). Thumb folded across palm (assumed, source silent). Little finger not modelled. Sign exists on BSL SignBank: https://bslsignbank.ucl.ac.uk/dictionary/regional/one-1.html (video only, no text handshape).

instruction: Show the number two: index and middle fingers up, others curled.
notes: Source: 'Index and middle fingers extended.' Ring curled, thumb folded (assumed). Finger spread not stated in source, set neutral. Little finger not modelled. SignBank: https://bslsignbank.ucl.ac.uk/dictionary/regional/two-1.html (video only).

instruction: Show the number three: index, middle and ring fingers up, thumb folded.
notes: Source: 'Index, middle, and ring fingers extended.' Thumb folded (assumed; source says thumb is not part of it). Real sign curls the little finger, which this hand does not have. Spread neutral. SignBank: https://bslsignbank.ucl.ac.uk/dictionary/regional/three-1.html (video only).

instruction: Show the number five: open hand, all fingers and thumb out.
notes: Source: 'All fingers and thumb extended.' Source gives no spread: fan of +/-0.3 and thumb out 0.5 is my estimate for a relaxed open hand. Little finger not modelled, so approximated. Thumb spread sign convention (+ = out to the thumb side) must be confirmed in hand/teacher.py. SignBank: https://bslsignbank.ucl.ac.uk/dictionary/regional/five-1.html (video only).

instruction: Show seven: thumb and index out like an L, others curled.
notes: Source: 'Thumb and index finger extended - held horizontal.' Middle and ring curled (assumed). The horizontal orientation is not checked by this app, so approximated. Thumb out 0.6 is my estimate for the L shape. SignBank: https://bslsignbank.ucl.ac.uk/dictionary/regional/seven-1.html (video only).

instruction: Make a closed fist, then circle it on your chest.

movement.note: Provisional format, stretch goal. Source: 'Closed hand makes a circular motion on chest.' Chest location is not checked; only the fist handshape is marked.

notes: Source: 'Closed hand makes a circular motion on chest.' Handshape is a plain fist (thumb folded assumed). Location (chest) and the circle are not judged by the handshape check, so approximated. Not checked against BSL SignBank (page not confirmed).

instruction: Show the number four: four fingers up, thumb folded.
notes: Source: 'Index, middle, ring, and little fingers extended.' Needs the little finger. On this hand the target equals THREE, so it cannot be told apart. Kept out of the demo.

instruction: Show the number nine: thumb and three fingers out, held horizontal.
notes: Source: 'Thumb, index, middle, and ring fingers extended - held horizontal.' The only difference from FIVE on this hand is orientation (not checked) and the missing little finger. Kept out of the demo.
